$comment: Vendor off-peak schedules for route leaves with offPeakOnly. weekdays use ISO numbering (1 = Monday, 7 = Sunday); utcWindows are half-open [from, to) UTC clock spans. excludeCalendarHolidays applies the Mainland China holiday calendar, and holidayUtcOffsetHours maps one instant onto that calendar's local date. Schedule names are policy data; code never names a channel.
